Package net.boricj.bft.image

Class RelocationFieldCursor

java.lang.Object
net.boricj.bft.image.RelocationFieldCursor
public final class RelocationFieldCursor extends Object
Generic cursor for reading and rewriting a relocation field in a section buffer.
